Interface ImplicitCallModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
RuleBasedImplicitCallModel
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ImplicitCallModel
Models calls that a method performs implicitly, e.g. Thread.start() calling run() on the thread, or Executor.execute(Runnable) calling run() on its argument. Call graph algorithms resolve the returned invocations like ordinary calls and attribute the resulting edges to the call statement that causes them.

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      @NonNull List<AbstractInstanceInvokeExpr> resolve(@NonNull ImplicitCallContext context, @NonNull Body body, @NonNull InvokableStmt stmt)
      Returns the invocations that the given call statement performs implicitly. Each invocation calls a method on a local of the given body; its arguments are the values that the implicitly called method receives, or NullConstant for parameters without a value.
      Parameters:
      context - the lookup and the analyzed methods of the analysis
      body - the body that contains the statement
      stmt - the call statement
      Returns:
      the implicit invocations, empty if there are none
